summary: Python is an easy language to start programming with.

questions.q: How do you print text on the screen in Python?
questions.answer: Use the built-in print() function and put the text inside quotes. Python runs the line and shows the text in the output.
algorithm: The text appears on the screen

questions.q: Write a program to add two numbers entered by the user.
questions.answer: input() always returns text, so convert both values to numbers with int() before adding them.
questions.code:
a = int(input("Enter first number: "))
b = int(input("Enter second number: "))
total = a + b
print("Sum =", total)
algorithm: Read the first number as a
Read the second number as b
